Our technology

Software narrows the field. People make the call.

Mutex Match ranks every opening against every available clinician on the things that predict a good placement. A recruiter reviews every match before anyone is contacted.

Request staff Find my match

What it never does

  • Submit a clinician without their say-so
  • Reject anyone without a person looking
  • Use anything unrelated to the work itself
  • Replace the conversation with your recruiter

What it weighs

The four things that predict a good fit

License and location

Where a clinician can practice today, and where they could with a little notice.

Unit experience

Recent, relevant experience in the unit, modality or setting the role needs.

Availability

Start dates, contract length and shift patterns that line up.

Preferences

The setting, schedule and pay goals each clinician has told us matter to them.

How a match happens

Four steps, one accountable recruiter

A need comes in

A facility request or a clinician search, with the details that matter.

The pool is ranked

Mutex Match scores the fit on license, experience, availability and preferences.

A recruiter reviews

A person checks the shortlist, talks to the clinician and confirms interest.

You decide

Facilities choose who to interview. Clinicians choose what to accept.

Why it matters

Faster, without cutting corners

Less waiting

Recruiters start from a ranked shortlist instead of a blank search.

Better conversations

Time saved on sorting is spent on the part that needs a human.

Nothing overlooked

Every available clinician is considered for every role, every time.
